caption:
Koko spends whole weekends crouched over the weeds and shifting pots, and the next day her back and forearms feel stiff.

Staying in one position for hours often leaves muscles tired. Switching tasks every 20 to 30 minutes can help share the load. Remedial massage can help ease tight muscles, and it tends to help most alongside staying active.

Hybi's garden prep: gently lean back 5 times before you start, use a kneeling pad, and switch tasks every 20 to 30 minutes. Stop if your leg tingles.

Pain spreading down a leg or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists and physios at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
